question: Which implementation approach ensures exact compliance with fitting conventions?
alternatives: Use off-the-shelf sklearn LogisticRegression (may differ in solver/clipping)
Implement custom gradient descent with exact specifications
Use numerical optimization library with constraints
rationale: Task requires exact conventions: specific gradient update formula, logit clipping to [-30,30], 200 fixed iterations, contiguous fold splitting. Custom implementation ensures verifiable compliance with all constraints.
decision: Implement custom full-batch gradient descent with exact update formula and logit clipping
expected_effect: Produces results exactly matching reference fit specifications. May be slower than library code but guarantees correctness.
falsifier: If custom implementation produces significantly different Brier scores than expected on standard datasets, revert to verified library solution
